{{Short description|Mathematical theorem}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Lyusternik–Fet theorem''' states that  on every compact [[Riemannian manifold]] there exists a [[closed geodesic]].<ref>{{SpringerEOM|title=Closed geodesic|oldid=46363|first=D. V.|last=Anosov}}</ref> It is named after [[Lazar Lyusternik]] and [[Abram Ilyich Fet]], who published it in 1951.<ref>L.A. Lyusternik, A.I. Fet, "Variational problems on closed manifolds" Dokl. Akad. Nauk. SSSR, 81 (1951) pp. 17–18 (In Russian)</ref>
